history_scope: All publicly advertised branches and their two reachable commits; current build_v4.py, both generations of datasets and lab_data_template.csv inspected. Private or local records were not accessed.
findings: HEAD build_v4.py selects 215 rows by Zn >= 3 wt.% and Zn > Cu, preserving the raw CSV first-column index in localization.
The 1154-row upstream CSV contains chemistry, coarse processing, mechanical properties and inferred class, with no per-row original-paper, specimen or experimental-series identifiers.
The public lab_data_template.csv contains an EXAMPLE row and is not laboratory evidence.
The older 300-record dataset is a different dataset, with no Bhat public-row crosswalk; its source labels do not authenticate these 215 Bhat rows.
Repository ownership establishes control of the downstream collection, but does not reconstruct missing upstream experimental identities.
resolved: All 215 public row mappings numerically checked, with 166 retained rows and 49 repeat representatives.
unresolved: Original study/specimen/series identities, extraction types and independence for the Bhat secondary corpus.

primary_source_context.finding: 1154 records assembled from literature and laboratory experiments; detailed thermomechanical temperatures/durations omitted. No per-row original source or specimen crosswalk found in the accessible article.

next_evidence: Original collection ledger assigning each public row to its original publication/table/condition and real series, or laboratory record. Individual specimen IDs are required only if the source actually reports individual measurements; means must stay means.
